integrity.reasoning: The work is a read-only portfolio audit that faithfully fulfills node-09's stated role. The report exists, is substantial (~491 lines), and covers every dimension named in the node's 'why': Needle/Gemma/Mercury pathway naming (assessed STRONG/showable), the Pi Capability Cascade concept (STRONG, with evidence the concept is implemented not just documented), repo hygiene (WEAK, with a severity-ranked evidence table), README/docs quality, and an explicit showable-vs-embarrassing summary. I spot-checked ~10 file:line and command-output citations against the live checkout (.github/ contents, .gitignore:38 and :49-50, .claude.md:4/9, infra-topology.md:4/12/17, needle/README.md:61/67, incident_report lines, IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md:59-60, auto-mode.json tracked-but-ignored, repo size ~160MB, missing droid-wiki/ and needle/HANDOFF-finetune.md) — all substantively accurate. The read-only constraint is honored: the only new file from this node is reports/pi-harness-execution/portfolio-audit.md (the landing commit 02ed684 also carried sibling nodes' audit reports, not node-09's concern). Critically for graph integrity, the report's final section delivers 12 actionable, testable acceptance criteria (AC-1..AC-12) each with a verification command, which is exactly the 'authoritative execution plan' that node-10-portfolio-execute's constraints say it must read and map to. node-10 depends_on node-09, and the handoff it needs is present and well-formed. Minor nit (one off-by-one line citation) does not change intent or graph integrity.
